description: M5 item 8 — LIVE profile manifest. A Live image carries the persistent root PLUS the installer and read-only recovery payloads. Built as an ISO from the Live Limine config (limine_test_terminal.conf), which lists all three boot modules: initrd.img + installer-esp.img + installer-bios.bin. The kernel's boot loader reports each payload's presence, so a Live boot must show the initrd AND both installer payloads available. This is the counterpart to tools/m8_installed_profile_markers.json (same image contents minus the Live-only installer). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m8_live_profile_markers.json --timeout 120 --boot-timeout 90

required.claim: the persistent-root initrd module is present on the Live image
the Live image carries the installer ESP payload (installer-esp.img module)
the Live image carries the installer BIOS stage payload (installer-bios.bin module)
the Live image booted to the terminal

forbidden.why: the Live image is missing its installer payload
the Live image is missing its installer BIOS payload
